retrievalProfile.description: A low-key, gritty barroom scene featuring a seated subject at a table with high-contrast lighting and a prominent neon-style script title in the lower third.

recipe.visualDefinition: A dimly lit interior shot of a man sitting at a wooden bar table, illuminated by a harsh directional light source that creates deep shadows. The composition is anchored by the diagonal line of the table and a large, stylized script title at the bottom right.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject positioned in the upper left quadrant leaning toward the center
Diagonal table edge leading the eye from center-right to the middle
High contrast between the warm-lit table surface and the dark, shadowy background
Typography layered over the dark foreground at the bottom
coreInvariants: Heavy chiaroscuro lighting with deep blacks
Warm, yellowish light on the table and subject's face

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Medium shot of a man seated, occupying the left half of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The brightly lit wooden table surface in the center-right.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the subject's face, follows the arm down to the table, and ends at the large script title at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive dark negative space in the background and lower left corner.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep shadows and blacks in the background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm amber and yellow tones on the table and skin.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Red and white highlights in the typography and beer bottle label.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation in the environment with high value contrast in the lighting.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid bright primary blues or greens
Limit to warm earth tones and deep blacks

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Casual brush script and clean sans-serif
letterConstructionRules: Main title uses a fluid, connected script with a slight italic slant
Secondary text uses a rigid, all-caps sans-serif
characterSpecificRedesigns: Script letters feature a soft outer glow to mimic neon
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between organic, fluid script and geometric, rigid sans-serif.
graphicDevices: Soft glow effect on script text

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the casual brush script feel
Matches the secondary sans-serif metadata text

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a grainy, low-key photograph of a man sitting at a wooden bar table with a beer mug and bottle. Use harsh side-lighting to create deep shadows in the background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large red and white gradient script title in the bottom right corner with a soft glow, and a small white condensed sans-serif subtitle just above it.

verificationChecks: Is the lighting high-contrast with deep blacks?
Is the script font fluid and glowing?

mustRedesign: Do not replicate existing brand logos on the bottle
postGenerationChecks: Check for high contrast between text and background
Ensure the grain doesn't obscure the subject's expression
Verify the script glow effect looks integrated
Confirm the diagonal composition is maintained
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a low-key barroom portrait with a glowing neon-style script title in the lower third for a moody, cinematic aesthetic.
